scope: Runtime Baseline II: PostgreSQL pool/backpressure, Redis, persistent worker queues, retries, dead-letter state and productive queue observability.

contracts.postgres: live PostgreSQL 16 SELECT samples plus a 12-query saturation burst against a pool capped at 4
contracts.redis: live Redis 7 PING, SET/GET, 32-operation concurrent INCR and TTL verification
contracts.workers: persistent NitradoJob rows cover PENDING/RUNNING/DONE/FAILED/DEAD and claim through FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with a bound of 4
contracts.observability: productive Prometheus gauges export queue depth by status, oldest pending age and worker in-flight count
contracts.ci: STAGE47_REQUIRE_LIVE=1 makes PostgreSQL, Redis and an empty residual mandatory in both complete test workflows

baselineNote: On exact SHA 17c5f4306ac7640c863d4954e4b4f39e0c227bc6, two independent live CI jobs observed PostgreSQL SELECT p99 <= 0.606 ms, Redis PING p99 <= 0.494 ms, Redis SET/GET p99 <= 0.927 ms, eight queued pool requests at saturation, an exact four-job claim bound and no residuals.
